title: Temple services renewed
summary: Jones dates the renewal of Temple services on 25 Kislev.
description: Jones dates the renewal of Temple services on 25 Kislev. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 165 BC (no higher-tier year available).
